sections.title: Financial Services Knowledge Chatbots
sections.description: For JPMorgan Chase, Goldman Sachs, Citigroup, and New York's world-leading financial institutions.

blocks.heading: Investment banking research chatbots
paragraphs: RAG chatbots for investment banking research analysts — querying financial models, market data, and research reports in natural language for JPMorgan's and Goldman's research organizations. SEC and FINRA recordkeeping requirements apply to electronic communications between AI systems and registered representatives — ClickMasters designs New York financial chatbots with FINRA Rule 4511 recordkeeping architecture.

blocks.heading: Retail banking digital chatbots
paragraphs: Customer service chatbots for JPMorgan Chase's enormous US retail banking customer base — account inquiries, transaction disputes, and product information for Chase's 80+ million US customers. New York State's consumer protection regulations apply to consumer financial services chatbots deployed by New York State-chartered banks.

blocks.heading: Wealth management client chatbots
paragraphs: AI assistants for the private wealth management teams at Goldman Sachs Private Wealth Management and JP Morgan Private Bank — querying portfolio performance, tax documents, and account information for the ultra-high-net-worth clients whose relationship with their private banker the chatbot augments.

sections.title: Healthcare Navigation Chatbots (Multilingual)
sections.description: For NYU Langone Health, Mount Sinai Health System, and New York-Presbyterian.

blocks.heading: Multilingual patient access chatbots
paragraphs: Patient scheduling and triage chatbots for New York's extraordinarily multilingual patient population — Spanish, Mandarin and Cantonese, Korean, Haitian Creole, Russian, Arabic, Bengali, Punjabi, and dozens of other languages are spoken by New York patients seeking care. ClickMasters designs New York healthcare chatbots with multilingual capability from the architecture phase.

blocks.heading: HIPAA + NY Health Privacy Act-compliant design
paragraphs: New York's health privacy protections (NY Public Health Law Article 27-F for HIV, Mental Hygiene Law for behavioral health) create healthcare chatbot requirements that go beyond federal HIPAA — ClickMasters designs New York healthcare chatbots with NY state health privacy law as a specific additional compliance requirement.

blocks.heading: Medicaid and MLTC navigation chatbots
paragraphs: Chatbots helping New York's large Medicaid and Managed Long-Term Care populations navigate coverage, benefits, and care access — the NY Medicaid market is one of the US's most complex and most significant.

blocks.heading: Regulatory compliance knowledge chatbots

sections.title: New York chatbot technical context
sections.description: Key technical considerations for New York chatbot deployments.

blocks.heading: FINRA recordkeeping for all financial chatbots
paragraphs: New York financial chatbots serving registered representatives must maintain FINRA-compliant electronic records. ClickMasters designs all New York financial service chatbots with FINRA Rule 4511 recordkeeping architecture.

blocks.heading: Multilingual at NYC baseline
paragraphs: 37% of New York City residents are foreign-born, and dozens of languages are spoken at home across New York's five boroughs. Multilingual chatbot capability is a baseline requirement for consumer-facing New York applications — ClickMasters designs New York consumer chatbots with at minimum Spanish, Mandarin, and one additional language based on the specific client's service area demographics.

blocks.heading: NYDFS oversight for financial and insurance chatbots
paragraphs: New York's Department of Financial Services is among the US's most active financial regulators — chatbots serving NYDFS-licensed entities must be designed with NYDFS supervisory examination readiness in mind.
